### The Significance of Genesis 3:15
Author: Derek Thomas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/significance-genesis-315
Passage: Genesis 3:15
Points:
- Establishes the Old Testament expectation of a coming Redeemer descended from Eve.
- Reveals God's covenant of grace, showing that redemption requires costly, substitutionary suffering.
- Identifies Satan's malevolent work behind human rebellion and world disorder.
- Guarantees from the beginning that the kingdom of God will ultimately triumph over darkness.

### The Proto-Evangelium
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/proto-evangelium
Passage: Genesis 3:14-15
Points:
- God immediately pronounces judgment upon the serpent, consigning it to humiliating defeat.
- Reveals that the conflict with the serpent represents an ongoing cosmic spiritual war.
- Announces the first gospel promise that Eve's ultimate descendant, Jesus Christ, will crush Satan.
- Assures believers that because Christ triumphed over evil, they share in His victory without fear.
